checks.lead: Nestor Apollonovich Lakoba (1 May 1893 – 28 December 1936) was a Soviet Abkhaz leader. He became a Bolshevik in the early 1910s and helped establish Soviet power in Abkhazia in the aftermath of the Russian Revolution. While in power, Lakoba served as First Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars of the Socialist Soviet Republic of Abkhazia from 1922 to 1930, and then as Chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Abkhaz Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic until his death in 1936.
